title: ArchitectureNode
description: A component instance in the canonical architecture graph. Position is presentation-only; evaluators must be position-insensitive.

type.description: Component catalog type (e.g. 'redis', 'load_balancer'). Must exist in the versioned component catalog.

technology.description: Optional concrete technology label distinct from the abstract type.

properties.description: Component-specific configuration (replicas, cache pattern, ttl, partition key...).

capacity.description: Effective capacity overrides for this instance; falls back to catalog capacity_defaults.

availability.description: Availability configuration: replicas, multi_az, multi_region, failover mode.
